title: Virtual Compute: outage exclusions
content:
## Meaning — outage exclusions

Virtual Compute outage exclusions: Incident cause codes excluded from service credits; string list.

## Tier values — outage exclusions

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — outage exclusions: customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for outage exclusions?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has outage exclusions of customer change; scheduled maintenance; upstream customer.
